interpretation: Exact unique parameter counts and ownership from meta tensors; dense FP32 P+G+M+V planning payload is 16 bytes/parameter for both arithmetic precisions. This is not measured runtime allocation.
The separate foreach allowance is one FP32 parameter payload; --no-foreach omits that allowance but not moments, gradients or per-Parameter operator temporaries.
State bounds include KV dtypes, int64 times and actual SSD logical convolution padding (up to 3*period+1 slots), not a universal four-event cache assumption.
Available headroom excludes activations/autograd, temporary banks, parameter gathers/casts, cross-partition copies, allocator overhead and checkpoint/host staging.
9B four cards leaves approximately 15.45 GiB on its busiest two partitions after dense AdamW plus steady BF16 state without foreach; actual training remains pending.

17B five cards still place the whole 544-node layer on one owner: 83.79 GiB dense AdamW persistent payload exceeds 60 GiB before activations. Layer placement cannot divide that layer; no node sharding expansion is claimed.

command:
import pathlib,subprocess,sys
from scripts.job import atomic
root=pathlib.Path("{run}")
rows=[]
for transport,precision in (("auto","bf16"),("synchronized","fp32"),("direct","fp32")):
    command=[sys.executable,"-m","scripts.check_placement","--devices","npu:0","npu:1","--precision",precision,"--transport",transport,"--threads","4","--output",str(root/(transport+"-"+precision+".json"))]
    code=subprocess.call(command)
    rows.append(dict(transport=transport,precision=precision,command=command,exit_code=code))
    atomic(root/"attempts.json",dict(state="running",rows=rows))
atomic(root/"attempts.json",dict(state="completed",rows=rows,scope="fresh processes after CANN Python path correction; original failures retained"))
sys.exit(int(any(row["exit_code"] for row in rows)))
